message: Black Friday is on, as planned. Rapid Parcel's drivers' union has said it may strike from December 1. We have booked 40% more capacity at Meridian and Dash for the next two weeks and added 100 support staff, so complaints are answered within a day. For eight weeks, if a product is proven fake, we refund double. Some parcels may still take longer than usual.
why: Most Black Friday orders ship in week 5.
Capacity and support are the levers on delay and complaints.
